description: Add or update up to 500 contacts by address in one call. New addresses are created. One already here is filled in (`mode: update`) or left alone (`mode: skip`). A blank value never erases one already stored. `subscribed: false` records that the person asked not to be emailed, and nothing here undoes it. A bad address fails only its own row: read `results` for each row's outcome. If the new contacts would pass the plan's limit, nothing is stored and it answers 402. The address of each contact it creates is checked when you hold the validate permission and address checks are turned on (get_email_check_setup); one already here keeps its verdict. `checks` says how many checks started, or why none did, and `checkAddresses: false` skips them. Checks never refuse the write: when this month's address checks are used up, the workspace's last payment didn't go through, or our team suspended the workspace, the contacts are saved and their checks wait on hold until the 1st of next month or the plan has room (`workspace_limit`), until the payment goes through (`payment_failed`), or until the suspension is lifted (`workspace_suspended`).

checkAddresses.description: Check the address of each contact this call creates. A contact already here keeps its verdict and gets no new check. `checks` in the answer says how many started, or why none did. True by default. It needs the validate permission and address checks turned on (get_email_check_setup). Without either, nothing is checked. If this month's address checks are used up, what you sent is still saved. The checks wait on hold until the 1st of next month or until the plan has room.

idempotencyKey.description: Your own id for this one call, such as a UUID, up to 255 characters. If the call fails with no answer, call again with the same key and the same arguments: within 24 hours, a saved answer comes back instead of a second run. A call left unanswered can run again after 15 minutes, so a send also keeps its intentKey or draft revision.
